purpose: Determine the language of source independence for the AusTraits replication without changing the admitted systems.
timing: Run only after the final AusTraits outcome-blind core is fixed and before real AusTraits memory rho is opened.

austraits_provenance.unit: distinct dataset_id contributing at least one eligible record to a final-core system
austraits_provenance.identifier: primary-source DOI parsed and normalized where available

bien_provenance.unit: distinct source_citation contributing eligible records to the fixed BIEN 201-system discovery core
bien_provenance.identifier: DOI parsed and normalized where available

overlap_metric: number of distinct AusTraits resolvable primary-source DOIs also present among BIEN resolvable source DOIs / number of distinct AusTraits resolvable primary-source DOIs
doi_coverage_metric: number of final-core AusTraits contributing dataset_ids with a resolvable primary DOI / all final-core contributing dataset_ids
caution: Even independent_source_replication refers to documented primary-source DOI overlap, not proof that no underlying measurements were ever shared.
